user.title: Where does the state of charge come from?
user.description: Pick the telemetry source for your vehicle's battery level. More sources are coming — today only PSA Car Controller is supported.

psacc.title: PSA Car Controller
psacc.description: The connection is tested before you continue, so a wrong address or vehicle ID is caught now rather than on the first poll tonight.

actuator.title: The plug
actuator.description: The switch that cuts power to the EVSE, and the sensor that reports how much it is drawing.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Optional signals and the rate model. Sensible defaults are filled in; you can leave them as-is.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the PSACC host. Check the URL.
error.no_vehicle_data: PSACC answered, but has no data for this VIN.

abort.already_configured: This PSACC source and VIN are already configured.
abort.unsupported_source: That telemetry source is not implemented yet.

ev_plug_charging_overheat_cutoff.title: EV plug overheating
ev_plug_charging_overheat_cutoff.description: The plug was switched off automatically because it exceeded its temperature limit. Inspect the plug and cable before re-enabling charging.

ev_plug_charging_bypass_detected.title: EV charging direct from the wall
ev_plug_charging_bypass_detected.description: The car is charging but not through the configured plug. Home Assistant cannot stop this charge -- unplug manually when done.

ev_plug_charging_evse_no_power.title: EV charging not detected
ev_plug_charging_evse_no_power.description: The plug is on and the car is plugged in, but no power has been detected for 5 minutes. The EVSE may need a manual reset.

ev_plug_charging_charge_not_started.title: EV charge not started
ev_plug_charging_charge_not_started.description: The charge window opened but the car's state of charge could not be trusted, so charging was not started.

ev_plug_charging_restart_reconciled_off.title: EV charge stopped after restart
ev_plug_charging_restart_reconciled_off.description: Home Assistant restarted while the plug was on outside the charge window with no record of who turned it on, so it was switched off as a precaution.

ev_plug_charging_aux_battery_low.title: EV 12V battery trending low
ev_plug_charging_aux_battery_low.description: The 12V auxiliary battery's 7-day resting average has fallen below 50%. Consider a trickle charge if this persists.

ev_plug_charging_aux_battery_critical.title: EV 12V battery critically low
ev_plug_charging_aux_battery_critical.description: The 12V auxiliary battery's resting state of charge has fallen below 30% -- low enough that the car may soon fail to wake or crank. Drive it for 30+ minutes or connect a trickle charger.
